purpose: Registration #3785: prevent an already-authenticated browser identity from surviving a password-proven transition into another account's membership-selection or MFA-pending flow. The branch is based on exact post-#4439 main where the bounded CVE governance and runtime-security manifest correction are already merged.
requiredBehavior: clear stale authenticated browser access, refresh, presentation/session and cabinet cookies only after the new account password has been accepted and the server has returned a bounded membership-selection or MFA challenge
immediately issue a fresh CSRF cookie after clearing the previous browser authority so the password-proven pending flow can continue
preserve control-plane SameSite strictness and public-platform SameSite lax behavior
do not create a session for the new account before membership selection and MFA complete
do not change API authentication, PostgreSQL identity, password, MFA verification, reviewer role, tenant derivation, RLS, audit or outbox authority
do not expose email, password, MFA setup secret, TOTP code, backup code, token or cookie in evidence
keep invalid-password attempts from silently logging out an already authenticated account
forbiddenCapabilities: MFA bypass or fake MFA completion
direct production SQL or identity mutation
reviewer password, TOTP secret, QR, backup-code or bearer handoff
RLS, CSRF, session, audit, outbox, security-scanner or rate-limit weakening
new paid provider, SaaS subscription or recurring cost
unrelated PC-CROP business-flow, Gekta, Company OS or showroom behavior changes
acceptanceEvidence: focused login security-boundary test requires stale authenticated browser cookies to be cleared for both password-proven pending paths
focused test requires a fresh CSRF cookie after the clear and preserves strict/lax SameSite boundary
ordinary authenticated-session cookies remain withheld until the new account completes membership selection and MFA
post-deploy reviewer ceremony must show the real MFA enrollment/verification flow and durable reviewer readiness must become password=1/1, TOTP=1/1, login-ready=1/1 before First Customer acceptance
